prompt: A travel app reads the text on street signs and menus from the camera.
tells: reads the text on street signs and menus
why: Reading text in images is OCR.
trap: Translation might come next, but first the text must be read.

prompt: Digitize handwritten field notes into editable text.
why: OCR reads printed and handwritten text.
trap: No specific fields are needed, just the text.

prompt: Read the serial number printed on each part as it passes a camera.
tells: serial number printed on each part
trap: Finding the part is detection; reading its number is OCR.

prompt: A library has millions of scanned book pages and wants all the words searchable, with no structure needed.
tells: all the words searchable, with no structure needed
why: Plain text from scans is OCR.
trap: Field extraction is for structured data; here, words are enough.
